scope: R177: three corrections about the AscendC build plumbing, and why the official ini route also fails

wrong_dynamic_py.consequence: R176's conclusion that the variable does not feed the compile was wrong; it was the wrong file

why_the_ini_route_still_fails.observed: after writing the ini the build emptied and rewrote it
why_the_ini_route_still_fails.conclusion: the ini is a build product regenerated during configure, so it cannot be pre-populated

recommended_next.option_a: private PYTHONPATH overlay of compiler/tikcpp/ascendc_kernel_cmake appending the three -isystem flags in get_op_desc; shared CANN untouched
recommended_next.option_b: bypass msopgen: manual bisheng .o build plus hand-built package, or a direct-call route just to obtain the timing

why_the_timing_number_matters: if the kernel reaches 1-2 ms per call the saving is 2.5-2.9 s per step, but at 10 ms it is only 1.3 s; nothing should be planned on 2.5 s before it is measured
